basis: Dysferlin-related myopathy directly damages skeletal muscle; no primary nerve involvement.
Benign smooth muscle tumour arising in the rectum.
Benign ovarian epithelial/stromal tumour; reproductive organ without an endocrine manifestation.
SETD1B-related developmental brain disorder with intellectual disability, language delay and seizures.
Pulmonary arterial hypertension and atrial septal defect define cardiovascular disease; leukopenia defines blood involvement.
Infection directly inflames the meninges of the brain or spinal cord.
Developmental brain disorder with intellectual disability, seizures and motor dysfunction; ocular and joint abnormalities each reported in only 1/5.
Clonal dendritic-cell disease; osteolysis 80-99%, chronic skin lesions 30-79%, hepatic infiltration with hepatomegaly 30-79%. Pulmonary disease 5-29% excluded.
Congenital erythrocytosis; PAH reported in 1/1 does not establish population frequency. Thrombosis and stroke are separately diagnosed complications.
Umbrella skeletal malformation disorder defined by abnormal digit number, fusion and phalangeal structure.
Loss of functional small intestine causes intestinal failure and malabsorption; nutritional consequences do not establish another damaged organ.
CEL-related diabetes with characteristic exocrine pancreatic dysfunction in most patients, often preceding diabetes.
Cranioskeletal and ectodermal dysplasia; renal disease is a major syndromic feature; structural dental defects 2/2. Ocular abnormalities 1/2 omitted by cap.
Gonadal dysgenesis, retinal dystrophy and myopathy define syndrome; hearing loss 2/3. Renal agenesis 2/4, dental and skin defects 4/4 omitted by cap.
Persistence of reproductive ducts in otherwise normally virilized males; isolated reproductive development disorder.
Inherited ventricular myocardial disease with fibrosis, dilatation and ventricular arrhythmia.
Nonsyndromic progressive sensorineural hearing loss; WFS1 alone does not imply diabetes or optic atrophy.
Intracranial meningioma affecting the choroid plexus; this is a CNS site, not the ocular choroid.
Inborn GABA catabolic disorders; developmental brain dysfunction, intellectual disability or seizures affect most patients across the group.
Autoimmune blistering skin disease; associated coeliac enteropathy is a separately diagnosed disease and is excluded.
Hamartomatous polyp arising in gastric mucosa.
Inherited podocyte/glomerular disease causing renal scarring; an immune mechanism is not established across this group.
Inherited melanin metabolism disorder defined by skin/hair hypopigmentation and structural ocular abnormalities with impaired vision.
Corneodesmosin deficiency causes chronic epidermal peeling and barrier failure; elevated IgE/eosinophils alone do not establish immunodeficiency.
Carcinoma arising in the prostate, a reproductive organ; urinary invasion or obstruction is not established as a common defining feature.
